items.prompt: Positional instance dff u(clk, din, qout) connects nets by…
choices: Port declaration order in the module
items.explain: First argument → first port in the module’s port list, and so on.

choices: Port d is wired to net din
Net din is renamed to d
d and din must be the same width
items.explain: .port(net) binds that port to that net; order on the line does not matter.

items.prompt: dff u(clk, qout, din) when ports are (clk, d, q)…
choices: Often compiles but swaps d and q — silent miswire
Is a syntax error in all tools
items.explain: Positional swaps of unlike ports compile; wrong wires show up in behavior.

items.prompt: Named port connections are generally preferred for multi-port modules in maintainable RTL.
items.explain: Named ports document intent and survive harmless reordering in the child module.
